entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that receives and processes EMM or ESM messages.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network infrastructure that receives and processes EMM or ESM messages.

entities.name: EMM STATUS
entities.description: A status message used in EMM procedures to report errors.

entities.name: ESM STATUS
entities.description: A status message used in ESM procedures to report errors.

entities.name: Conditional IE error
entities.description: Cause value #100 indicating a conditional IE error (missing, unexpected, or syntactically incorrect conditional IE).

entities.name: Conditional IE error condition
entities.description: Condition where a message contains missing, unexpected, or syntactically incorrect conditional IEs.

relations.description: UE behavior is triggered when a conditional IE error is diagnosed.
UE sends EMM STATUS message when conditional IE error occurs in EMM context.
UE sends ESM STATUS message when conditional IE error occurs in ESM context.
EMM STATUS message includes cause #100 for conditional IE error.
ESM STATUS message includes cause #100 for conditional IE error.
Network behavior is triggered when a conditional IE error is diagnosed.
Network may send EMM STATUS message when conditional IE error occurs in EMM context.
Network may send ESM STATUS message when conditional IE error occurs in ESM context.
